context_requirements: Expression of SLC8A1 (NCX) or TRPC3/5/6 in the assayed cell line
A signalling context in which sodium/calcium exchange or TRPC-mediated calcium entry is active at baseline
Acute calcium-dependent transcriptional programmes that can be modulated within 6-24 h
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that is absent in vehicle controls and not explained by generic stress
Evidence of calcium-dependent immediate-early gene induction (e.g., FOS, EGR1) after treatment
